settings.name: AllowBulkExecution
settings.value: true for load; false for individual measured operations
settings.reason: Concurrent raw item creation uses the SDK bulk path. Individual operations use the ordinary gateway client to avoid bulk batching delays; emulator remains unranked.

settings.name: PartitionKeyPath
settings.reason: One partition per base64url transport identity; key retains the original marketplace collection/n identity.

settings.name: IndexingPolicy
settings.value: Explicit scalar, array and composite paths requested after ingestion
settings.reason: Record returned mode and progress. The emulator can accept policy updates without applying them; never infer physical index creation from HTTP success.

settings.name: protocol
settings.reason: .NET SDK requires HTTPS; trust the local emulator certificate in the functional adapter.

development.reason: Readiness smoke only; budgets below 6 GiB scale cache settings in Start-BenchEngine.ps1. Not official measurements.
